map.输入：桌数 15、单价 5 元/枝、伴娘 4 人、胸花 8 人、桌花=中型（15:
Input: tables 15, unit price 5 CNY/stem, bridesmaids 4, corsages 8, table flowers=Medium (15 stems/table), checked items=bride bouquet/bridesmaid/corsage/table flowers/arch.
Stems per item: bride bouquet 25×1=25; bridesmaid 12×4=48; corsage 4×8=32; table flowers 15×15=225; arch 300×1=300.
Total stems = 25+48+32+225+300 = 630 stems.
Estimated cost = 630×5×1.12 (including 12% spare) = 3528 CNY.
Conclusion: this plan needs about 630 stems, budget about CNY 3528; adding mother wrist flower (+12), welcome floral (+75), aisle petals (+5) etc. will increase further.

map.鲜花有损耗（运输折损、开放不均、现场补花），工具在总量×单价基础上加 12% 作: Fresh flowers have loss (transport damage, uneven opening, on-site refill); the tool adds 12% on total × unit price as spare fund to avoid running short on site. Actual purchase can reserve 10-15%, and raise the spare ratio further when valuable flowers take a high share.
